nl: Run tools/check.py for each of the services cache, queue, files in parallel in the background and wait for all of them. Which services failed (non-zero exit code)?

entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

time.sleep(0.3)
failing = {"db", "queue", "mail"}
print(f"{sys.argv[1]}: {'failed' if sys.argv[1] in failing else 'ok'}")
sys.exit(2 if sys.argv[1] in failing else 0)

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/check.py", "cache"] background: true label: "cache"
run ["python3", "tools/check.py", "queue"] background: true label: "queue"
run ["python3", "tools/check.py", "files"] background: true label: "files"
jobs wait: 60s |> filter exit_code != 0 |> select label
